card.who: Geoffrey Agar, 62, solicitor and honorary alderman. Agar & Co let half the Hook. Wants the cold-store road quiet and bought before the docks are redeveloped.
card.speak: Courteous, slow, every sentence a letter. Never raises his voice; sends paper instead.
card.life: Lives up in town. Calls at the agents' office on Cold Store Road on Tuesdays and Fridays.
